kunui.title: Kun Visual Novel UI Library (KunUI)
kunui.details: KunUI is a modern headless UI component library designed for ACGN websites. It currently supports Vue / Nuxt (React, Next.js, SolidJS, and SolidStart planned): top-tier SSR support, ultra-low latency, zero external dependencies, and production-ready, helping you ship web apps faster.
